div.head: Family Apolemiidae
div.p: Apolemia uvaria is not well documented in the literature and it was not taken during any of the major oceanographic expeditions of this century. Leloup (1955) considered the species to be common in both the Atlantic and Indian Oceans, as well as in the Mediterranean, and to have a wide depth distribution. The findings of Fraser (1961Fraser ( , 1967) ) showed that the species was not only present in the oceanic warm-water fauna, but also in the colder waters of the North Sea, thus indicating a fairly wide temperature tolerance.
